item.title: Middle East war live: Trump claims he called off an Iran strike to allow for ‘serious negotiations’
item.description: US President Donald Trump on Monday claimed that he was holding off on a military strike on Iran planned for Tuesday at the request of Gulf State leaders because “serious negotiations” were under way. The president threatened that Washington was ready for a "full, large-scale assault of Iran” if an acceptable deal is not reached. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.

item.title: Drone strikes UAE nuclear plant highlighting risk of renewed war
item.description: A drone strike sparked a fire on the edge of the United Arab Emirates' sole nuclear power plant on Sunday in what authorities called an "unprovoked terrorist attack."

item.title: Israeli attacks in Gaza have stepped up since halt in bombing in Iran
item.description: At least five Palestinians were killed in Israeli strikes on the Gaza Strip on May 17. Israel has stepped up attacks in Gaza in the weeks since halting its ​joint bombing ‌with the US in Iran. Netanyahu's government says Hamas fighters are tightening their grip on the strip. The devastated Palestinian territory has seen near-daily Israeli fire since the ceasefire between Israel and Hamas went into effect in October.
